messages:
Jordan: Heads-up 1: new bench run for Lodestar12b-int6 and int6b finished. I uploaded the detailed slices + human-annotated diffs. Can product & GTN folks eyeball high-risk slices? https://ci.internal/lodestar/bench/3309991234 :mag_right:

Priya: Quick summary pls? We need a one-liner for PMs while they read diffs.

Tomas: One-liner: int6 ~2.6x token-cost reduction vs fp16; int6b ~2.3x. Overall GTN accuracy gap: int6 -1.6% macro, int6b -0.9%. Latency: median down ~6ms; p95 +12-20ms depending on KV warm state.

Nora: Which slices actually move the needle for product?

Jordan: Notable regressions by slice (human-checked):
```
- product-names (NER-heavy): int6 -4.5% acc, int6b -2.6%
- legal-clauses (long context): int6 -1.0%, int6b -0.4%
- code-completion (formatting): neutral to slightly better
- slot-filling (short prompts): int6 -1.8%, int6b -0.7%
```
Small but frequent NER misses are highest-visibility (search snippets, invoices).

Leah (prod): If product-names are at -4.5% that will show to users. What mitigations are cheap?

Tomas: Options: 1) hybrid routing: keep NER-sensitive routes on fp16; 2) post-hoc rescoring: call fp16-only microservice for low-confidence entity spans; 3) dual-run for golden queries. Cost & complexity differ.

Priya: Can we quantify the cost of rescoring per 10k requests? Assume avg toks/request=3.2k, rescoring covers 12% of requests, fp16 cost= $0.012/1k toks, int6 cost= $0.0046/1k toks.

Jordan: Calc (rough): rescoring 12% requests -> extra fp16 tokens = 0.12 * 10k * 3.2k = 3.84e6 toks. Cost ~ (3.84e6/1k)*$0.012 = $46.08. Savings from base switch to int6 for whole 10k reqs = 10k * 3.2k toks * ($0.012-$0.0046)/1k = (32e6/1k)*$0.0074 = 32e3 * 0.0074 = $236.8. Net = ~$190.7 saved per 10k requests/day. Numbers scale linearly.

Leah (prod): That looks promising. Does rescoring add latency to user flows?

Tomas: If done async (post-response rerank for snippets), UX hit is minimal. For inline entity-dependent flows we might need sync rescoring which adds ~30-60ms depending on kvcache. We can limit sync rescoring to top-k candidates with confidence threshold <0.6.

Nora: Any differences across locales or long-tail queries? We saw more regressions on non-en long names in the sample. Need to flag locales in rollout.

Jordan: Good point. Slice breakdown by locale: en: -3.8% on product-names, de: -5.1%, ja: -6.3% (small sample sizes). Recommend holdback for ja/de until we verify.

Priya: Proposed rollout plan:
- Phase 0: shadow logging for 48h (no user traffic) capturing per-route signals + locale breakdown + above-the-fold diff logging.
- Phase 1: 1% live, hybrid routing rules: route flagged NER routes to fp16; enable async rescoring for snippets (12% sample). Monitor NER precision/recall, p95 latency, and locale error deltas. 48h.
- Phase 2: 5% live if Phase1 OK. Add int6b trial on 5% for comparison.
- Phase 3: 20% live with expanded rescoring and locale holdbacks removed as validated.
- Auto-rollback: any route with >2.0% absolute NER precision drop for 2 consecutive buckets (1h) -> immediate rollback to previous config.

Tomas: Engineering effort estimate: routing flags + per-route locale tag: 3 dev-days. Async rescoring pipeline: 4 dev-days (reuses existing scorer). Telemetry dashboard: 2 SRE-days to add locale-sliced signals + alerts.

Leah (prod): GTN asks: what to say in messaging? Keep it simple: "~2-2.6x cost reduction with targeted safeguards for entity-sensitive features; rolling pilot starting at 1%." Include 4 anonymized before/after snippets.

Nora: I will prepare the anonymized diffs and highlight the non-en failures. Jordan please include the short sample list for GTN.

ci-bot: Canary artifact for lodestar12b-int6 uploaded -> https://ci.internal/artifacts/3309991234 (sha: deadbeef) at 3309991299

Jordan: Action items: Nora upload diffs + locale spreadsheet, Tomas set up routing flags PR, Priya finalize rollout doc and cost table, Leah draft GTN blurb and attach 4 examples. We'll sync after the 48h shadow.

Priya: I'll also run a sensitivity table varying cache hit (20/50/80%) and batch efficiency to give finance a best/worst savings bucket.

Leah (prod): Thanks all. If the 1% pilot looks clean, PMs will greenlight 5% next week.
